title: Hatred Stems from Ignorance! Distillation of the Persuasion Modes in Countering Conversational Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and benchmarks models on the domain of 'religious bigotry' (alongside racism and sexism), specifically mapping target groups like 'MUSLIMS' and 'JEWS' to this category to analyze how different persuasion modes are used to counter religious hate speech.
